meta.title: High-grade B-cell lymphoma (double-hit) in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 (+/- BCL6) rearrangements (double-hit / triple-hit)
meta.population: Adults with FISH-confirmed double/triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma - THE ENTITY WITH TWO NAMES: the registry's cleanest classification-divergence teaching, VERIFIED both halves - WHO-HAEM5 (Alaggio, Leukemia 2022, PMID 35732829) calls it 'DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements' and REMOVED the MYC/BCL6 cases (reclassified by morphology into DLBCL-NOS or HGBL-NOS), while the ICC (Campo, Blood 2022, PMID 35653592) keeps 'HGBL with MYC and BCL2' AND retains a provisional 'HGBL with MYC and BCL6' - the same tumor earns different names under the two current classifications, and this trainer prints both. FISH DECIDES: the diagnosis requires REARRANGEMENTS, never expression - the double-expressor look-alike (MYC IHC >=40% + BCL2 >=50%, the revised-4th-edition-2016 cutoffs, verified; ~23% of DLBCL) is a DIFFERENT, dlbcl-trainer problem. ~5-15% of DLBCL-morphology cases carry MYC-R (verified range, wider than folklore); the NCCN-selective FISH strategy would miss ~1/4 of BCL2-rearranged DH/TH and ~1/3 of ALL DH/TH (verified verbatim) - the universal-vs-selective FISH debate is live and taught.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the double-hit entity - the registry's final spec, closing the catalog. THE SIGNATURE IS A PRECISION-WORDED EVIDENCE HOLE (correction 63rd forced the wording): NO RANDOMIZED TRIAL HAS EVER DEMONSTRATED THAT INTENSIFICATION BEATS R-CHOP IN DOUBLE-HIT HGBL - and the wording matters, because a randomized trial DID enroll DHL: Alliance A051701's double-hit cohort randomized DA-EPOCH-R +/- venetoclax and was HALTED FOR HARM (on-treatment deaths 17% vs 3%; median OS 8.5 months vs not-reached - the add-on arm did worse, verified; correction 62nd: harm, never…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: WHO-HAEM5 'DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements' AND ICC 'HGBL with MYC and BCL2 (+/-BCL6) rearrangements' - both printed, the divergence taught (the MYC/BCL6 category is the fault line); HGBL-NOS is a separate entity in both; triple-hit classifies with the MYC/BCL2 group; borders - DLBCL-NOS and double-expressor reroute LIVE to the dlbcl trainer (whose subtype gate already reroutes here: the registry's fourth reciprocal pair); Burkitt (simple karyotype, TdT-negative) and TdT+ B-lymphoblastic territory block
meta.response: PET-CT response conventions (Deauville, held in the dlbcl trainer by reference); the 12-month relapse line inherited from the dlbcl architecture; CNS surveillance per the risk chapter

refs.label: THE TWO NAMES, verified both halves: WHO-HAEM5 (Alaggio, Leukemia 2022 - PMID 35732829, pubmed-url-match) = 'DLBCL/HGBL with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements'; MYC/BCL6 cases EXCLUDED and 'reclassified... into DLBCL or HGBL-NOS categories respectively based on morphology' (verified snippet); ICC (Campo, Blood 2022 - PMID 35653592, pubmed-url-match) = 'HGBL with MYC and BCL2' + PROVISIONAL 'HGBL with MYC and BCL6 rearrangements' (verified snippet). HGBL-NOS separate in both; triple-hit classifies with the BCL2 group. TRAPS: PMID 36701168 is a COMMENT on the ICC paper, not the paper (cite 35653592 only); the Alaggio paper has a published Correction AND a near-identically-titled MYELOID sibling (Khoury) - exact-title match required | PMID 35732829 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE LOOK-ALIKE, verified: double-EXPRESSOR = MYC IHC >=40% + BCL2 >=50% WITHOUT rearrangement ('the revised 2016 WHO classification recommends cutoff values of 40% for MYC and 50% for BCL2' - verbatim, PMID 34282799; pooled DE incidence in DLBCL 23% [20-26%] - verbatim); 'distinct from double-hit lymphoma, which involves dual translocation' (verbatim). Worse-than-average DLBCL, often ABC, NO intensification mandate (memory-grade prognosis receipts: Johnson/Green JCO 2012 lineage). THE CUTOFF TRAP: 40/50 trace to the revised 4th edition (2016), NOT WHO-HAEM5 - cite accordingly | PMID 34282799 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

FISH DECIDES + THE TESTING DEBATE, verified: MYC-R in 5-15% of de-novo DLBCL (verbatim - wider than the 10-15% folklore); THE MISS RATES verbatim (Davies Hematol Oncol 2019 + Blood 2024 'FISHing for clarity'): NCCN-selective triage (GCB + IHC) 'would miss approximately one quarter of tumours with DHL or THL with BCL2 rearrangements and one-third of all HGBL-DH/TH'; UK NICE 'recommends that all patients with DLBCL should be screened by FISH'; pragmatic fallback = MYC-first with reflex BCL2/BCL6

THE CONVENTION'S ANCHOR, verified verbatim: Dunleavy DA-EPOCH-R (Lancet Haematol 2018 - PMID 30501868, pubmed-url-match; NCT01092182): prospective multicentre SINGLE-ARM phase 2, n=53 MYC-rearranged - 'After a median follow-up of 55.6 months, 48-month event-free survival was 71.0% (95% CI 56.5-81.4) and 48-month overall survival was 76.7% (62.6-86.1)' (VERBATIM); double-hit subset n=24, ~73% 48-month PFS (MIRROR grade - secondary source, not the primary abstract). THE TITLE TRAP: the CT.gov record's title ('Burkitt... and c-MYC+ DLBCL') differs from the paper's - never cross-wire | PMID 30501868 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE RETROSPECTIVE, verified verbatim: Petrich (Blood 2014 - PMID 25161267, abstract read FIRSTHAND via efetch 2026-08-20): n=311 DHL - 'Intensive induction was associated with improved PFS, but not OS' (VERBATIM, confirmed) AND the abstract's OTHER half, now printed: 'Correcting for these [multivariate risk factors], intensive induction was associated with improved OS' - the unadjusted and adjusted reads DIVERGE and the honest teacher holds both; '49% remain alive at 2 years' verbatim; median PFS 10.9 / OS 21.9 months verbatim; the 6-yr prognostic split (>95% to <40%) is BODY-level, not abstract-level - grade noted | PMID 25161267 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE NEGATIVE NEIGHBOR, verified: CALGB/Alliance 50303 (Bartlett, JCO 2019 - PMID 30939090, pubmed-url-match): DA-EPOCH-R vs R-CHOP in frontline DLBCL - NO EFS/OS superiority, MORE toxicity. THE TRAP: it was a de-novo DLBCL trial, never DHL-enriched or DHL-stratified - citing it as double-hit evidence is the documented error; its honest use is the both-directions divergence (don't escalate in DLBCL; the DHL convention stands on other, weaker legs) | PMID 30939090 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE HARM RECEIPT (corrections 62nd/63rd), verified: Alliance A051701 (NCT03984448; ASH 2021, Rutherford/Abramson): the DHL cohort RANDOMIZED DA-EPOCH-R +/- venetoclax (n=66: 30 vs 36) - on-treatment deaths 3% vs 17% (sepsis x4, cardiac arrest x2); ORR/CR numerically worse (73/67% vs 58/50%); median OS NOT-REACHED vs 8.5 months (p=0.004) - the add-on arm did WORSE and accrual was SUSPENDED. The receipt behind two disciplines: venetoclax property-banned, and the absence claim precision-worded (a randomized trial DID enroll DHL - it tested an add-on and harmed; 'no randomized trial has DEMONSTRATED intensification beats R-CHOP in DHL' is the only true sentence; NCT03479918 also registered)
refs.src: ASH 2021 + trial record (verified; the wording discipline)

refs.label: THE CNS CHAPTER, verified: RISK - Oki (BJH 2014 - PMID 24943107, pubmed-url-match): 'cumulative incidence of central nervous system involvement was 13% at 3 years' (VERBATIM, n=129 DHL). PROPHYLAXIS CONTESTED - Orellana-Noia (Blood 2022 - 34570876, matched): single-route IT-vs-IV across 21 US centers, NO significant CNS-relapse difference; Lewis (JCO 2023;41(35):5376-87 - PMID 37797284, RESOLVED by closure sweep, pubmed-url hit; adjusted 5-yr risk difference 1.6% [95% CI -1.5 to 4.4], no meaningful reduction); the 2026 JCO editorial LITERALLY TITLED 'End of Methotrexate for CNS Prophylaxis in DLBCL' vs a rival 2026 analysis claiming benefit for 3g/m2/3h - the literature contradicts itself and a definitive RCT is considered infeasible. THE SAME-FAMILY TRAP: Lewis-2023 vs the 2026 ultra-high-risk analysis (JCO-26-00947) are different papers - never conflate | PMID 24943107 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: BJH + Blood + JCO x3 (verified; contest printed)

refs.label: THE CAR-T DELTAS, graded exactly: ZUMA-7 (Locke, NEJM 2022 - DOI NEJMoa2116133 SOLID; the integer PMID held at MEMORY GRADE, never printed as verified): axi-cel arm 17.6% double-hit vs 8.4% SOC - an ARM IMBALANCE, flagged; TRANSFORM (Kamdar, Lancet 2022 - PMID 35717989, pubmed-url-match): '23% had high-grade B-cell lymphoma (double/triple hit)' (VERBATIM); BELINDA: tisa-cel FAILED 2L (3L-only - the product-matters lesson); THE REAL-WORLD EXTENSION (Blood Cancer J 2025 - PMID 40140360, matched): 80 DHL + 74 DEL among 408 CD19-CAR-T patients, 13 centers - benefit extends to DHL | PMID 35717989 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

POLARIX at exact grade: Tilly (NEJM 2022 - PMID 34904799, pubmed-url-match; n=879): double/triple-hit INCLUDED at ~6-8% (26 pola-R-CHP vs 19 R-CHOP patients). THE MIS-PARSE TRAP: circulating '38%/41% double-hit' figures are a subgroup-denominator mis-parse - DISCARD; pola-R-CHP is an option with a small DH fraction, never a DHL-specific answer

STARGLO + INTER-SWEEP CONFLICT #3 (CLOSED FIRSTHAND 2026-08-20): Dickinson (Lancet 2024 - PMID 39550172, matched): glofit-GemOx vs R-GemOx, n=274 - OS-positive (extended median 25.5 vs 12.9 months; the first randomized ph3 OS win for a CD20xCD3 bispecific in DLBCL). THE CONFLICT, updated by resolution sweep 2026-08-20: formally UNRESOLVED but now LEANING EXCLUSION - every accessible description (Lancet title/abstract, ODAC coverage, the ASH 3-yr follow-up) frames the population as 'relapsed or refractory DIFFUSE LARGE B-CELL LYMPHOMA' - never 'LBCL', never HGBL - and the 'broadly incl. HGBL-DH' reading found ZERO support in anything retrieved; the exclusion is still not verbatim-confirmed from protocol text (absence-of-evidence, said as such), so STARGLO remains NOT cited as HGBL evidence. Its US regulatory arc is now better sourced: FDA ODAC voted 8-1 AGAINST the applicability of the STARGLO data (2025-05-20; Roche statement) - the representativeness question, on the record. EPCORE DLBCL-1: the 2026-01-16 topline reads CONFLICT (correction 65th) - the AbbVie release was read as positive by one sweep while clarification coverage ('Genmab/AbbVie clarify...') reports a MISSED primary endpoint in R/R DLBCL - leaning MISSED; full publication is the arbiter; HGBL-inclusion still unverified. TARGETED SWEEP 2026-08-20 (WebSearch-only): (a) STARGLO's exclusion lean STRENGTHENED - search-layer text now directly quotes 'double or triple hit lymphomas, or high-grade B-cell lymphoma were ineligible for enrollment' (ODAC-adjacent; STILL not primary-verified - named closers: FDA briefing doc fda.gov/media/186520 and the NCT04408638 registry eligibility text); (b) THE CONFUSION HAZARD documented: companion phase Ib NCT04313608 explicitly INCLUDES high-grade LBCL in its title - the plausible source of the earlier 'broadly included' read (distinct NCT; does not bear on STARGLO's phase 3); (c) EPCORE DLBCL-1: dual 2026-01-16 PRs confirmed (AbbVie+Genmab), search-layer PFS HR 0.74 (0.60-0.92) with CRR/DoR gains but NO met-primary language anywhere retrieved - leaning-missed stands; the formal Genmab/AbbVie CLARIFICATION release EXISTS but its body is unread (the arbiter's forerunner), and an EHA 2026-06-12 presentation is reported (unverified lead). THE CLOSURE: the restored CT.gov API returned NCT04408638's exclusion criteria VERBATIM - 'High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangements, and high-grade B-cell lymphoma not otherwise specified, as defined by 2016 WHO guidelines' - alongside transformed-indolent and PMBCL: STARGLO enrolled NO double-hit disease; the 'broadly included' read is REFUTED (traced to companion ph Ib NCT04313608) and the never-cited-as-HGBL-evidence restraint is now registry-proven

THE CENSUS: EPCORE DLBCL-2 (NCT05578976, ph3 epcoritamab+R-CHOP - inclusion list NAMES 'HGBL with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangement' - CONFIRMED FIRSTHAND 2026-08-20: 'High grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL-2 and/or BCL-6 rearrangement with DLBCL morphology' verbatim, composite/HGBL-NOS excluded; ACTIVE-NOT-RECRUITING [enrollment complete], est. primary completion 2027-06); OLYMPIA-3 (NCT06091865, odronextamab+CHOP, 'including high-grade'; Part 1A 100% CR / 1B 85% CR reported; randomized portion ongoing) - and OLYMPIA-1 (NCT06091254) is FOLLICULAR (correction 59th, removed); SKYGLO (NCT06047080 - name corrected from 'SKYGLOW', 60th; glofitamab+pola-R-CHP ph3 - firsthand 2026-08-20: ACTIVE-NOT-RECRUITING, est. primary completion 2027-10; registry eligibility NEITHER names NOR excludes HGBL - the answer is protocol-level, still open); mosunetuzumab+DA-EPOCH (NCT06249191 - MYC-R REQUIRED, recruiting US: the enriched exception); selinexor/XPO-1+R-CHOP DH/TH (NCT05974085 - firsthand 2026-08-20: DH rearrangement REQUIRED verbatim in inclusion; registry status UNKNOWN/stale, est. PCD 2023-12 passed); ZUMA-23 (NCT05605899 - ACTIVE-NOT-RECRUITING per 2026-04 record: a WATCH not a door, correction 61st; design confirmed by resolution sweep: IPI 4-5 LBCL, leukapheresis -> 1 cycle R-CHOP/DA-EPOCH-R bridging -> axi-cel vs 5 further chemo cycles, PRIMARY = EFS by blinded central review, CNS lymphoma excluded; the CT.gov histology list now READ FIRSTHAND 2026-08-20: inclusion names 'High-grade B-cell lymphoma (HGBL)' VERBATIM under the WHO-2016 LBCL umbrella [DH/TH not sub-specified]; status ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING firsthand; ESTIMATED primary completion 2031-03 - a LONG watch, no near-term readout). DESERTS: the no-HGBL-only claim CORRECTED (64th): HGBL-exclusive trials exist but are rare - HOVON-152 (NCT03620578: DA-EPOCH-R + nivolumab consolidation, newly diagnosed HGBL-DH/TH ONLY, ph2 NL - 'does NOT admit non-HGBL' verified - now WITH RESULTS at PREPRINT grade, targeted sweep 2026-08-20: SSRN 4891725, Chamuleau et al - 63/96 [66%] CMR after induction proceeded to nivolumab consolidation; 2-yr DFS 86% [78-96], 2-yr OS 95% [90-100] - NOT peer-reviewed, numbers search-layer), NCT03479918 (R-BL-M-04 vs R-(DA)-EPOCH+ASCT, HGBL-DH + HGBL-NOS - firsthand 2026-08-20: registry status UNKNOWN/stale, est. PCD 2021-03 long passed - likely a dead record), ChiCTR2100048811 (venetoclax+DA-EPOCH-R, DH/TH - NOTE: the same combination A051701 halted for harm, running elsewhere); NONE phase 3, none US-randomized, so 'no trial ever PROVED the intensity' stands; no US prospective CNS-prophylaxis trial (single-country prospective studies of unverified status only)

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
